stories.head: True Anomaly raises $190M for co-orbital security
stories.body: True Anomaly has secured a $190 million Series C funding round, emphasizing its focus on co-orbital security and space domain awareness. With a valuation of $1.6 billion, this funding reflects a strong pull from the Department of Defense, underscoring the growing importance of space security. The company aims to enhance its capabilities in a sector that is increasingly competitive.
stories.soWhat: Investors are betting heavily on the idea that space security is the next frontier, which might make for some interesting boardroom discussions.

stories.head: Anduril and L3Harris team for SDA constellation
stories.body: Anduril and L3Harris are collaborating on a tactical Space Development Agency constellation bid, aiming to leverage their combined expertise in defense technology. This partnership comes amid a broader trend of consolidation in the defense sector, as companies seek to pool resources for competitive advantage. The tactical nature of this bid indicates a shift towards more integrated defense solutions.
stories.soWhat: In defense contracting, partnerships can be as fleeting as a shooting star, but this one could be a harbinger of more strategic alliances.

stories.head: Astrobotic sells to Voyager for lunar ambitions
stories.body: Astrobotic has announced its sale to Voyager Technologies, a move designed to scale up lunar lander production. The terms of the deal haven’t been disclosed, but it signals a strategic pivot towards increased lunar exploration capabilities. This acquisition reflects a growing recognition that collaboration may be key to thriving in the increasingly crowded lunar market.
stories.soWhat: In space, teaming up can often lead to better outcomes than going solo, especially when the competition is as fierce as it is now.

watchlist.title: Keep an eye on Astroscale's growth strategy
watchlist.body: With new funding in hand, Astroscale's shift from demos to regular missions could signal a more aggressive push into the space debris market.

watchlist.title: Jio's LEO constellation IPO plans
watchlist.body: India's Jio Platforms is laying out a sovereign LEO constellation plan ahead of its IPO, which could reshape the competitive landscape in satellite communications.

watchlist.title: Palantir's TITAN extension impact
watchlist.body: Palantir's $480 million extension on the TITAN program may influence future government contracts, especially in the ground station sector.

watchlist.title: Watch for hypersonic test delays
watchlist.body: The continued delays in hypersonic glide-vehicle tests raise questions about the viability of this technology, which could impact defense budgets.

talent.statLabel: Job orders YoY · plus 2 starters per head, an 8-year first
talent.head: Demand has doubled. So has our hit rate.
talent.body: EVONA's job orders are up 2.0× year-over-year, and for the first time in our eight-year history we're placing two new starters per EVONA staff member. The first number says demand is real. The second says we're converting it, which in recruitment is the only number that actually matters. Growth is heaviest in Series B/C startups; primes are running flat. Compensation isn't the variable. The constraint is schedule risk in the primes: senior engineers leave Boeing, Lockheed, Northrop because they want to ship hardware before retirement.
